title: Isifungo Sabangakazalwa
intro: Umphefumulo oqotho wenza isithembiso esingcwele ngaphambi kokufika komntwana. Indaba yalomuntu ivele ngaphakathi kwezindonga zendlu engcwele, lapho ukuzinikela kuhlangana khona nokwamukelwa kwaphezulu. Ungubani lo mkhonzi ka-Allah?
clues: Ngenze isifungo esiqinile sokunikela ingane yami engakazalwa enkonzweni ka-Allah.
Ngesikhathi ngibeletha, ngamangala ukuthola ukuthi kwakuyindodakazi, yize ngangilindele indodana.
Ngaqamba ingane yami ngokuthi uMaryam, igama elibonisa ukuzinikela kanye nenkonzo.
Ngacela isivikelo sika-Allah sengane yami kanye nenzalo yayo kuSathane oqalekisiwe.
Ingane yami yamukelwa yiNkosi futhi yabekwa ngaphansi kokunakekelwa nguMprofethi uZakariya endaweni engcwele.

location.label: Isici Esiyinhloko
options: Indawo engcwele (i-mihrab) lapho umntwana wakhe abekwa khona
location.answer: Indawo engcwele (i-mihrab) lapho umntwana wakhe abekwa khona

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
